title: Understanding Verification Vulnerabilities in Cross-chain Bridges: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.13170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, numerous heterogeneous blockchains have emerged, each featuring distinct architectures, consensus mechanisms, and application ecosystems. Cross-chain bridges have consequently become a critical infrastructure component, typically relying on smart contracts to facilitate message passing and asset transfers across heterogeneous blockchains. Unlike single-chain contracts, bridge contracts introduce additional verification logic to validate external-chain data, such as state proofs, message sender identities, and signatures. However, correctly implementing such logic is challenging. We refer to vulnerabilities that violate the security guarantees of cross-chain verification as Cross-chain Verification Vulnerabilities (CVVs). translated_title: 理解跨链桥中的验证漏洞：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 随着区块链技术的快速发展，涌现出大量异构区块链，每条链都具有不同的架构、共识机制和应用生态系统。跨链桥因此成为关键的基础设施组件，通常依赖智能合约来促进异构区块链之间的消息传递和资产转移。与单链合约不同，跨链桥合约引入了额外的验证逻辑来验证来自外部链的数据，例如状态证明、消息发送者身份和签名。然而，正确实现此类逻辑具有挑战性。我们将违反跨链验证安全保证的漏洞称为跨链验证漏洞（CVV）。为了刻画CVV，我们首次对这一漏洞类别进行了系统性实证研究。通过分析来自36个真实世界跨链（桥）的588份安全审计报告……
tldr: 本文首次对跨链桥中的跨链验证漏洞（CVV）进行了系统性实证研究，通过分析来自36个真实跨链桥的588份安全审计报告来刻画这一新型漏洞类别。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic empirical study of Cross-chain Verification Vulnerabilities (CVVs), characterizing this vulnerability class by analyzing 588 security audit reports from 36 real-world cross-chain bridges.
